title: Ushairi (Theme 6: Maadili)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 5 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child recites with the beat of the mizani and finds every answer and word meaning in the lines of the poem.

floor.prerequisite: Counts the mizani of a line.
floor.question: Mshororo "Heshima ni kitu bora" una mizani mingapi?

representations: the poem on a chart, beti numbered
a two-meaning card for one word
steps: Clap the beat of one line.
Find the word in its line and test its meaning.
Answer from the line and say the message.
contexts: a church or mosque youth group

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child recites the ubeti with the claps and says the meaning of "taji" in this line.

misconceptions.ask: Ukifunga shairi, unaweza kueleza funzo lake?
misconceptions.repair: Ujumbe ni funzo la shairi lote kwa maneno yako mwenyewe.

listen_for: kusoma maneno yote kwa kasi moja bila kusimama
misconceptions.ask: Mapigo ya mshororo huu ni mangapi?
misconceptions.repair: Kariri kwa mahadhi: fuata mapigo ya mizani na usimame mwisho wa ubeti.
Katika shairi, neno linaweza kuwa na maana ya picha: taji hapa ni fahari.

misconceptions.ask: Ni mshororo upi unaotoa jibu hilo?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu swali kwa kutumia maneno ya shairi.

checks.question: Ujumbe wa shairi kuhusu heshima ni?
